raw_goal: I work on an agent security team researching prompt injection and jailbreak attacks against LLM-based agents (tool-using systems, computer-use agents, multi-agent frameworks). I want papers proposing novel attack techniques or concrete defense mechanisms for agentic systems. Not interested in: general LLM safety alignment (RLHF, constitutional AI), model-level jailbreaks against standalone chatbots, or new benchmarks/evaluation suites unless they introduce a fundamentally new threat model.
